name: agy-connectors
description: Includes the Chatski Google Chat left-sidebar panel (powered out-of-the-box by your Gemini Enterprise Google Chat / Teams Connector or optional Direct Chat REST API) plus the zero-install Gemini Enterprise (GE) federated connector bridge for Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Gmail, Drive, GitHub, and BigQuery.
suggestedPrompts: Run /chatski to catch up on unread Google Chat spaces and direct messages via my Gemini Enterprise Chat Connector
Run /connect-ge to link my Public Sector Gemini Enterprise instance and test my federated connectors
Search my federated SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook via Gemini Enterprise for recent program updates
